# Summary

This prompt is used to refactor and rename season-specific registration terminology to "Team" throughout the codebase.

# Description

The "Club" entity and concept is ok and dont need to be renamed, but the season-specific registration concept is more accurately named "Team".
This prompt will help you identify and refactor all season-specific registration terminology to "Team" in the codebase, including variable names, class names, method names, and any other relevant references.

# Goal

The goal of this prompt is to ensure that season-specific registrations consistently use "Team" terminology in the codebase, improving clarity and consistency.
Areas to cover:
- Domain models and entities
- Database tables and columns
- API endpoints and request/response models
- Import statements and module names
- Variable names and method names
- Documentation and comments
- Test cases and test data
- Configuration files and environment variables
- Any other relevant references in the codebase
